ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In the butterfly diagram, which part of the life cycle is indicated by letter V?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The butterfly life-cycle diagram is on the right side of the image. It shows adult butterflies near the top, a small oval/circle stage on the right marked with the letter V, then arrows leading downward toward later stages such as the caterpillar and chrysalis. Reasoning: In a butterfly life cycle, adult butterflies lay eggs, eggs hatch into caterpillars, caterpillars form chrysalises, and adult butterflies emerge. Since letter V is beside the small oval/circle stage after the adult butterfly, V indicates the egg stage.
